rows.name: Breakdown of the average residential tax bill by town service, FY1997 budgeted
rows.printed_heading: Lunenburg Board of Assessors / Breakdown of the Average Residential Tax Bill / Fiscal Year 1997 / Town Service or Budget Category | Budgeted Amount | Percent of Tax Levy | Cost to Average Taxpayer
rows.what_it_is: NEW DATASET. The Assessors spread the FY1997 budget over the average residential bill: budgeted amount, its share of the levy and its cost to the average taxpayer, by service. No dataset holds this in any year. Category rows (e.g. `Education 8,352,477`) print with their lines below them, so a column sum counts each category twice. `TOTAL COST OF TOWN SERVICES 12,742,557` (p46) equals the p83 omnibus `TOTAL BUDGET $ 12,742,557`: the page treats the whole omnibus as the levy at 100.0000%. The percent and cost columns are the Assessors' derivation, not a measurement (rule 7). NEEDS.md The page prints a CATEGORY row (`Town Administrative 561,672`) ABOVE its lines, then a blank row: the validator sums every row against the total and fails on the grouping, not the figures, so its column checks are off (checks=none) and the rows are `no check`. By our sum the eight category rows close on 12,742,557 exactly; NEEDS.md asks for a category-above-block identity
rows.columns: Town Service or Budget Category | Budgeted Amount | Percent of Tax Levy | Cost to Average Taxpayer
rows.layout: Textract p45 table 1, 49 rows x 4 cols; Textract p46 table 1, 28 rows x 4 cols
rows.notes: landed in report-tax-bill-breakdown: 68 rows. fiscal year 1997, BUDGETED (p45: `Breakdown of the Average Residential Tax Bill / Fiscal Year 1997`; column `Budgeted Amount`) -- a budget, not an actual (rule 1)
